acceptance_criteria: Inbound DC email creates rows. Outbound message generates correct headers. Group chat dedup works. Expiry GC fires. Integration test passes.
description:
## Why this issue exists

The bridge is the core of JMAP Chat on stoa. Without it, JMAP Chat messages cannot reach Delta Chat users and inbound Delta Chat emails cannot be surfaced to JMAP Chat clients. All other epics depend on this one.

## Schema

Add the following tables to the stoa-mail Postgres schema (new migration files):

```sql
CREATE TABLE chats (
    id            TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,   -- ULID
    user_id       BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    kind          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('direct','group')),
    dc_group_id   TEXT,                        -- Chat-Group-ID header value; NULL for direct chats
    contact_email TEXT,                        -- direct chats: peer email address
    name          TEXT,                        -- group chats: display name
    created_at    BIGINT NOT NULL,
    last_message_at BIGINT,
    muted         BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    mute_until    BIGINT,
    UNIQUE (user_id, dc_group_id),
    UNIQUE (user_id, kind, contact_email)      -- prevent duplicate direct chats
);

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
    id               TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,  -- ULID assigned by receiving mailbox
    chat_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_id        TEXT NOT NULL,              -- 'self' or email address
    sender_msg_id    TEXT NOT NULL,              -- sender-assigned ULID or email Message-ID
    body             TEXT NOT NULL,
    body_type        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text/plain',
    email_message_id TEXT,                       -- cross-ref to RFC 5322 Message-ID for DC bridge
    reply_to_id      TEXT REFERENCES chat_messages(id),
    sent_at          BIGINT NOT NULL,
    received_at      BIGINT NOT NULL,
    sender_expires_at BIGINT,
    burn_on_read     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    deleted_at       BIGINT,
    deleted_for_all  BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    edited_at        BIGINT,
    delivery_state   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    UNIQUE (chat_id, sender_msg_id)
);

CREATE TABLE chat_contacts (
    id            TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- email address IS the contact id
    user_id       BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    display_name  TEXT,
    first_seen_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at  BIGINT NOT NULL,
    blocked       BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    autocrypt_key BYTEA,                         -- most recently seen Autocrypt public key
    PRIMARY KEY (id, user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE read_positions (
    id                   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,  -- ULID
    user_id              BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    chat_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    last_read_message_id TEXT REFERENCES chat_messages(id),
    last_read_at         BIGINT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (user_id, chat_id)
);

CREATE TABLE presence_status (
    id           TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,  -- ULID
    user_id      BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    presence     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online',
    status_text  TEXT,
    status_emoji TEXT,
    expires_at   BIGINT,
    receipt_sharing BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    updated_at   BIGINT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE chat_reactions (
    id                 TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,  -- ULID (senderReactionId)
    message_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    emoji              TEXT NOT NULL,
    sent_at            BIGINT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (message_id, id)
);
```

Add indices: `(chat_id, received_at)` on `chat_messages`; `(user_id)` on `chats`, `read_positions`.

## Inbound bridge (Delta Chat email → JMAP Chat Message)

Triggered on SMTP delivery when the message has `Chat-Version: 1.0`.

Steps:
1. Parse `Chat-Group-ID` (group) or `From`/`To` pair (direct) to identify or create the `chats` row.
2. Look up or create a `chat_contacts` row for the sender (using `From` email as id).
3. Store Autocrypt public key if `Autocrypt:` header is present.
4. Extract plain-text part as `body`. Extract attachments (deferred — blob upload path not yet wired).
5. Map `Ephemeral-Timer` header → `sender_expires_at`.
6. Insert `chat_messages` row with a new ULID as `id`, `email_message_id` = RFC 5322 `Message-ID`.
7. Create `read_positions` row for this chat if not already present.
8. Emit JMAP state-change (state token bump on `Message` and `Chat` for this account) so push layer notifies connected clients.

Headers to handle:
- `Chat-Version: 1.0` — presence triggers the bridge
- `Chat-Group-ID` — group chat identifier
- `Chat-Group-Name` — initial/updated group display name
- `Autocrypt` — store public key on the contact row
- `Ephemeral-Timer` — map to `sender_expires_at`
- `Chat-Disposition-Notification-To` — record that sender wants an MDN read receipt
- `Secure-Join-*` — store as opaque metadata on the message; do not process

## Outbound bridge (JMAP Chat Message → Delta Chat email)

Triggered when `Message/set` create succeeds for a chat where at least one participant is a non-stoa user (i.e., contact_email is an external address).

Steps:
1. Build RFC 5322 message:
   - `From:` owner email
   - `To:` / `Cc:` contact email addresses from chat membership
   - `Message-ID:` newly generated per RFC 5322
   - `Chat-Version: 1.0`
   - `Chat-Group-ID:` (group chats only) — `chats.dc_group_id`; assign one if not yet set
   - `Chat-Group-Name:` (group chats, on first message to a new member)
   - `Autocrypt:` owner's public key (if Autocrypt key material available)
   - `Ephemeral-Timer:` (if `senderExpiresAt` is set)
   - `Chat-Disposition-Notification-To:` owner email (to receive read receipts)
   - Plain-text body from `Message.body`
2. Enqueue for SMTP delivery via the `OutboundMailer` trait (stoa-y0p2j).
3. Update `chat_messages.email_message_id` and set `delivery_state = 'delivered'` on SMTP success.

## MDN (read receipt) handling

When the owner marks a message as read (`Message/set` with `readAt`) and the original email had `Chat-Disposition-Notification-To`:
- Generate an MDN email per RFC 8098 and enqueue for delivery.
- Delta Chat clients interpret MDN as a read receipt.

## Expiry GC

A background task runs periodically and hard-deletes `chat_messages` rows where `sender_expires_at < now()`. Hard-delete means row removal, not tombstone. Affected message `id` values appear in subsequent `Message/changes` responses in the `destroyed` list.

## Acceptance criteria

- Inbound Delta Chat email with `Chat-Version: 1.0` creates or updates `chats` and `chat_messages` rows
- Outbound `Message/set` create generates a valid Delta Chat email and enqueues it for delivery
- Group chat identified by `Chat-Group-ID` across multiple messages correctly mapped to one `chats` row
- Autocrypt key stored on first contact, updated on subsequent messages
- `Ephemeral-Timer` ↔ `sender_expires_at` round-trips correctly
- MDN sent when owner marks a message read and original had `Chat-Disposition-Notification-To`
- Expired messages hard-deleted by GC task; appear in `Message/changes` destroyed list
- Integration test: receive a fixture Delta Chat email, verify `chat_messages` row created; send a chat message, verify outbound email has correct headers
design: ChatContact.id = email address is the key design decision enabling Delta Chat interop without any protocol negotiation. The bridge sits at the SMTP delivery hook — same place the sieve filter and DKIM verifier run. email_message_id cross-reference on chat_messages enables dedup on re-delivery and MDN correlation.
title: JMAP Chat: schema and Delta Chat bridge layer
